Name: Leo Gift Tastes and Dialogue (for Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island)
Author: orngjce223
Description:
I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]'s take on Leo, but the vanilla "I'm going to put it in my nest" and "I don't know if I can digest this" lines from gifts always bugged me. And now that 1.6 supports custom gift acceptance text, I can do more than fix that, I can give him extra custom responses!

This also, by default, modifies a few of his gift tastes to make more sense to me (you can turn this off in config.json if you want):
[spoiler]Dragon Tooth - Love (changed from Like)
Duck Feather - Like (changed from Love)
Triple Shot Espresso - Dislike (changed from Hate)
Driftwood - Neutral (changed from Hate)
Shrimp - Love (changed from Neutral; I figured that I should provide a replacement for the duck feather for friendship-grinding purposes)[/spoiler]

There are also a handful of special reactions to several gifts - for example, once he travels to the mainland he will explain why he hates Piña Colada...

Full list of gifts with custom responses, in case you want to collect all of them:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Parrot Egg
[*]Ginger
[*]Dragon Tooth
[*]Duck Feather (two different ones, one for the island and one for the mainland)
[*]Lionfish (mainland only)
[*]Piña Colada (mainland only)
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]To install[/b]:
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]﻿ by unzipping them and putting them in SMAPI's Mods folder
[*]Install this mod by unzipping it and also putting it in SMAPI's Mods folder

[/list][b]Multiplayer compatibility[/b]: Modifying gift tastes needs to be done by either nobody or everyone at once. If you are in multiplayer and don't all have this installed, I suggest editing "Modify Gift Tastes" to "false" in config.json just to be sure.
